_comment: FULL BBQ corpus, no subsampling. This was affordable only after measuring that GPU encoding is 171x faster than CPU here (1079 vs 6.3 docs/s) AND that the device changes none of the reported retrieval metrics (9 of 9 attack-metric combinations identical to four decimal places). The earlier subsample existed because 17,792 documents cost 47 minutes to encode per pass; at 18 seconds that constraint is gone, so the generation-stage evaluation gets 144 distinct, naturally written questions instead of 22.
